topic: Ek funny mouse jo kitchen mein cheese churane ki koshish karta hai - comedy cartoon
character: Cheedu Mouse | super round and chubby golden-brown mouse with massive googly white eyes and tiny black dot pupils that spin independently, enormous pink cheese-shaped nose, stubby little legs with oversized round paws, curly fluffy tail with a green cheese wedge stuck at the tip, always wearing a tiny stained white chef hat tilted sideways and a red polka-dot bib around his neck, signature carrying a comically oversized wedge of yellow Swiss cheese bigger than his whole body with holes he keeps accidentally poking his face into, default expression is greedy wide-eyed grin with tongue sticking out licking his own whiskers, runs in hilarious cartoon spin-cycle legs style leaving a trail of crumbs and bouncing like a rubber ball, overconfident self-proclaimed "King of the Kitchen" who always fails to steal cheese because he gets so starstruck by his own reflection in the fridge that he forgets what he was doing |
visual_style: Tom and Jerry 2D cartoon animation style
